# teams_recording_roll_out_policy (Resource)

Manages the RecordingRollOutPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsRecordingRollOutPolicy / Get-CsTeamsRecordingRollOutPolicy / Set-CsTeamsRecordingRollOutPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsRecordingRollOutPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `meeting_recording_ownership` (String) Maps to the -MeetingRecordingOwnership parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
